meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order after clearing all fields shows validation errors
gaps: Assert that every required field in the Recreate Order window shows an error when the complete set of required fields is not known to the catalog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that every required field in the Recreate Order window shows an error when the complete set of required fields is not known to the catalog.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order window.
Clear all values in the Recreate Order window.
Submit the cleared form to trigger required-field validation.
Verify the cleared Product field reports a field-level required error.
Verify the cleared Quantity Requested field reports a field-level required error.
Verify the validation dialog remains open after the rejected submission.
